svg.title: SDLC plugin layers
svg.desc: Layer map of the sdlc plugin by structure. Top to bottom: 17 commands, 21 skills grouped by orchestrator phase (Define, Build, Prove, Ship with Learn), 10 agents, scripts, templates, and the files written into the user's repo (.sdlc/, docs/sdlc/, .claude/, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, knowledge/). Hooks (security-guidance, hookify, verify-freshness, model-router with role-guard and trust-anchor) run on six Claude Code events outside the stack. The optional sdlc-extras companion plugin (plugins/sdlc-extras/) holds the Ralph loop and its Stop hook, hookify's list, configure and help commands, and the conversation-analyzer, type-design-analyzer, comment-analyzer and code-simplifier agents; the boxes below still show them in core until the diagram is relaid out. Packaging, the other hosts' manifests, tests, docs and licenses sit underneath.
svg.text: How sdlc 1.8.1 is built, from what the user types down to what lands in their repo. Each band is one plugin structure and arrows show who calls whom.
Hooks sit outside the stack because Claude Code fires them, not the workflow.
start hands the feature to the orchestrator; other commands load one skill or run a script
dispatch fresh subagents with a phase-specific brief
commands and skills (not agents) run these for state and facts the model should not guess
scaffold.py copies and tracks template files
generated into the user's repo; committed unless marked git-ignored
